attach.debug.text:
Do you want to attach debug files? This will include logs and crash information that can help developers fix the issue.

Note: Debug archive size can reach up to 10 MB.

To find and fix the issue, a detailed description of the actions taken before the game crash is necessary. The more detailed, the better.
A relevant  save file is even more helpful in identifying the problem.
